heat.value_semantics: source-normalized 0–100 WBGT indicator; value 0 is source NoData, not degrees Celsius

wbgt.value_semantics: UrbClim 2 m Wet Bulb Globe Temperature, degrees Celsius, daily maximum, on a 100 m grid in EPSG:3035; computed with the Liljegren et al. (2008) method following ISO 7243
